title: Node Search/Filter in Canvas View
description: Add a search/filter input in the toolbar or a slide-out panel that allows users to quickly find nodes by name, description, or any SIPOC field content. When a match is found, the canvas should auto-pan and zoom to highlight the matching node(s). Use React Flow's fitView with specific node IDs to focus on results. NEW FINDING (2024-2025): React Flow now has an official NodeSearch UI component (from @xyflow/react) that provides customizable search and node selection out-of-the-box. Check if the project's @xyflow/react version includes this component. If so, integration is even simpler than building from scratch. The official docs describe: 'You can override this behavior by passing a custom onSearch function. You can also override the default onSelectNode function to customize the behavior when a node is selected.' Reference: https://reactflow.dev/ui/components/node-search. Especially valuable when value streams grow beyond 10+ nodes, showing the tool is designed for real-world use cases.
